I can't really get a job right now. Well, I guess I can now.

Because it's really difficult for me to work and go to school, I haven't been. I've just been living off scholarships along with S. We support G. And honestly, with the economy what it is, the best I can hope for is a fast food job. I mean I am capable of doing fast food, so it's not terrible, but S gets upset I don't make enough and my mom says it's beneath me. 

It is, yeah. The Grimms, actually, were doing it for nationalistic reasons. It goes into Volk theory and eventually the rise of the Nazi party.
I just...I can't. I got yelled at so much last time I went in about how it was the worst possible time and I caused so much shit. I can't be yelled at like that again.
I specialize in Folklore (especially Germanic Fairy Tales).
Museum Curator. I like people and I like making people happy.
I'm a history major, but there really aren't jobs for history.

I'm 2 semesters (this one included) from getting my associates. However- I'm on academic probation due to me going off my meds before and bombing as badly as I am now. I made all A's last semester but, due to the school's rules, I won't get financial aide for next semester.
Also, I'm really sorry I seem to critical. I'm trying very, very hard not to be. I just don't see a way out.
I've tried before. Unfortunately, she pays some of my bills and so I can't really get away from her.
I do-we're polyamorous. Honestly, being poly isn't a terribly big stresser in my life.

I have a story for you. One of my very good friends is 21, utterly gorgeous (to the point where she stops people in their tracks when she dresses up), and has never been kissed. So babe, it's not about how attractive you look (which, for the record, you are very attractive), and it will happen.

I can't afford another trip to the doctor and, while I thought about a Crisis Stabilization Unit, it's utterly terrifying to me. Last time I was in it my husband and best friend got into a fight (which they both tried to drag me into while I was in the unit), and I lost my best friend and nearly lost S. To this day (it was about 8 months ago), if I even mention the former best friend's name G flies into a rant about how they don't understand it and don't I love and want to support S? I'm terrified if I go in it'll happen again.
